summary: State reset: unconditionally zeroes three DWORD fields of the this-object (command counter at 0x7C, slot lookup table pointer at 0xC4, current marker byte at 0x178), then via the sub-object pointer read from this+0x190 zeroes a byte at sub-object+0x50 (byte-stuffing mode flag), a byte at sub-object+0x51 (control flag), and a DWORD at sub-object+0x58 (byte counter, flattened to this+0x1E8). Returns the sub-object pointer. Existing analysis interprets the context as a JPEG decoder prepared for a fresh decode session. No conditional guards; every write is unconditional.
